done.title: FEATURE: client-side on-site search — build a JSON index at build time + a tiny no-dependency search box filtering titles/descriptions (no server)
done.changed: Shipped end-to-end on-site search. Local Qwen dev authored assets/search.js — a dependency-free progressive-enhancement script that fetches the build-time search-index.json and turns the static list into a live client-side filter (term-AND matching, title/tag-weighted ranking, ?q= deep-link support, aria-live result count, XSS-escaped output, graceful fallback on fetch error). PM wired build.py: a search_text() helper that flattens page/post body markdown into indexable plain text, ONE search_items list that drives BOTH docs/search-index.json (compact, 11 items) and the static no-JS browsable list on a new /search/ page (so index and list can never drift), plus the header .hsearch box (base.html) and a {scripts} template slot. Local Qwen also authored the search CSS block (header box, results cards, .visually-hidden a11y label, responsive 2-up grid, empty state). Zero JS required to use the page — it renders the full list and every page/article is reachable; JS only enhances it. Validated: build green (9 pages + 1 post), all index SEO checks + single-h1 sweep pass, search-index.json valid, /search/ has canonical+title+desc+single-h1+no-JS list, search.js passes node --check, JSON-LD valid sitewide, sitemap includes /search/.
